source_ref: vendor/gyms/agentgym/agentenv-textcraft/agentenv_textcraft/recipes/{golden_sword,stick,birch_planks}.json (real Minecraft crafting recipe files loaded by CraftingTree._load_recipes and validated by TextCraftEnv.step's craft/get regex actions in environment.py)

steps.description: get 2 minecraft:gold_ingot (gold_ingot's only recipe file, gold_ingot.json, is type 'minecraft:smelting', which CraftingTree._load_recipes skips, so it is not craftable and is a valid 'get' target per environment.py's get-action check).
get 1 minecraft:birch_log (a raw block with no crafting recipe file in agentenv_textcraft/recipes/, so it is a valid 'get' target).
steps.source: environment.py TextCraftEnv.step 'get' branch; absence of a birch_log recipe file in agentenv_textcraft/recipes/

steps.description: craft 4 minecraft:birch_planks using 1 minecraft:birch_log, per birch_planks.json's minecraft:crafting_shapeless recipe (ingredients: [{tag: minecraft:birch_logs}], result: {item: minecraft:birch_planks, count: 4}).

craft 4 minecraft:stick using 2 minecraft:birch_planks, per stick.json's minecraft:crafting_shaped recipe (pattern ['#','#'], key {'#': {tag: minecraft:planks}}, result: {item: minecraft:stick, count: 4}).

craft minecraft:golden_sword using 2 minecraft:gold_ingot, 1 minecraft:stick, per golden_sword.json's minecraft:crafting_shaped recipe (pattern ['X','X','#'], key {'#': {item: minecraft:stick}, 'X': {item: minecraft:gold_ingot}}, result: {item: minecraft:golden_sword}).
